label: D1 fixation step with a moderate lean toward a1 (typically after a common a1->S1 trial)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). Within D1 it tracks the agent leaning moderately, not strongly, toward a1: 94% of activation mass falls in the D1 policy-logit band choice in [2.8, 8.1], none for choice < -1.5 or > 8.1, and none when value > 7.7. In terms of observed history, 78% of mass comes right after a trial where the agent chose a1 and commonly reached S1 (prev_action==1 & prev_common==1; rate ~0.002 after a2 trials, ~0.004 after rare transitions). The strongest activations follow an unrewarded common a1->S1 trial (precision 0.45, but only 41% of mass), i.e. when the agent still prefers a1 but less confidently. Long rewarded a1 streaks (high value, very confident) mostly do not fire it. The feature is sparse inside these regions (precision only ~0.2-0.25), so it is only partly explained: it looks like a sparse code for a moderate a1 preference at D1 whose exact gating is not captured. No future variables are used; choice is the agent own policy logit at that step.
